test_title: SSC CHSL Exam 2023 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jan, 2024 Shift 1).
subject: general
question: The compound interest of ₹6,000 in two years, if the rate of interest is 2.5% per annum for the first year and 2% per annum for the second year, will be:
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹6,000

Rate for 1st year (r₁) = 2.5%

Rate for 2nd year (r₂) = 2%

Time (t) = 2 years

**Formula used:**

Amount after 1st year, A₁ = P × (1 + r₁/100)

Amount after 2nd year, A₂ = A₁ × (1 + r₂/100)

Compound Interest (CI) = A₂ - P

**Calculations:**

A₁ = 6000 × (1 + 2.5/100)

⇒ A₁ = 6000 × 1.025

⇒ A₁ = 6150

A₂ = 6150 × (1 + 2/100)

⇒ A₂ = 6150 × 1.02

⇒ A₂ = 6273

CI = A₂ - P

⇒ CI = 6273 - 6000

⇒ CI = 273

**∴ The correct answer is ₹273.**
